Hi. I cannot give you odds. ICA decides every application, and our consultant looks at your full profile before saying anything. Two quick questions so I book you with the right person. What is your nationality?

I understand, and nobody should have promised you an outcome. Our consultant will go through what happened last time and tell you plainly whether a second application makes sense. That conversation is on Zoom or at our office. Which do you prefer?
zoom. how much do you charge?

Booked. Thursday 11am on Zoom, and the calendar invite is on its way. Our consultant takes it from here. If you need to change the time, message here.

flow.step: It answers the first message in minutes
flow.detail: Day or night, on your own WhatsApp number. The lead is messaging other agencies at the same time, so the first reply matters. It answers in English or the mixed English your leads type. If many of your leads write in Chinese, tell us before you count on it.

flow.step: It asks the qualifying questions, one at a time
flow.detail: Nationality, pass type, years in Singapore, income band, and who is applying. It gives no odds and makes no assessment. Pass types your form turns away, such as Work Permit, get a polite no, so your consultants spend their time on cases they can take.

flow.step: It quotes your fee and answers the objection
flow.detail: If you want the fee stated up front, it quotes from your price list. When a lead says another company promised them heaven and earth, it answers in your words, from the scripts and SOPs you give us, and says plainly that ICA decides.

Zoom or your office, whichever the lead prefers. The lead picks a time, the calendar invite goes out, and the lead can change the time in the same chat. Once the consultation is booked, the agent stops selling and your consultant takes over.

flow.step: It follows up until the lead replies
flow.detail: It tries again a few hours later and keeps trying over the following week, until they answer or ask it to stop. "Get back to me next week" sets a reminder for next week. Leads nobody has chased in months can be messaged again from an export of your old chats, with a WhatsApp approved message.

On Pro it also writes each lead and booked consultation into your CRM, if it is one we have connected before, and can pass the record on by webhook to a tool like Zapier. It does not read your Facebook lead form and it does not connect to Privyr today, so ask us before you count on either. Email is not a channel. faq: Can an AI agent tell a lead whether they qualify for Singapore PR?

No. Eligibility is a judgement call and ICA decides every application. 41 Closer asks the qualifying questions, nationality, pass type, years in Singapore and income band, and books the consultation. The assessment stays with your consultant. We would not build it any other way.
What does it say when a lead asks you to guarantee approval?

It says that nobody can guarantee approval and that ICA decides. Then it offers the consultation, where your consultant can look at the case properly. If the lead was promised results by another company before, it answers in your words from your scripts. It never promises an outcome.
Our leads come from Facebook lead forms. Can the agent message them first?

Not from the form. The agent only talks to people who message your WhatsApp number. Switch the ads to click-to-WhatsApp and every lead opens a chat with the agent instead of filling a form. For old leads, export the chats from your current number and we send them a WhatsApp approved message from a list.

It answers in English and the mixed English your leads type. If many of your leads write in Chinese, tell us before you count on it, and we set it up so your team reads every chat in English. A voice note is read too.
What happens after the consultation is booked?
The agent stops selling. The calendar invite goes out and your consultant takes over. The lead can still message the same number to change the time. The agent does not chase documents after signing.
How much does an AI agent for an immigration consultancy cost?

Starter is S$690 a month and Pro is S$1,490 a month. The build is included and there is no setup fee. Connecting a CRM we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400. One month to start, charged from go-live, then month to month with 30 days notice. Eligible Singapore SMEs can apply the EDGE grant, which replaced the EDG on 30 September 2026, to part of the cost, up to 70% of qualifying costs.
How long does it take to go live?

Live in 48 hours from your price list and scripts. We build the agent first and you message it yourself before you pay anything. Then one free hour where we walk you through the platform and connect your WhatsApp. Your team tests it on real leads before any client sees it.
Can my three salespeople all use it at the same time?

Yes. Each person gets their own login, and you choose whether they are an owner, an admin or staff. They see every chat in one inbox and can step in on any conversation. When the agent is unsure of an answer, it asks your team on WhatsApp and remembers the answer next time.
